newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 666 retail money market mutual funds rose $4.25 billion to $604.74 billion in the week ended November 20, the Investment Company Institute, an industry group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 410 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $3.46 billion to $493.29 billion, while assets of the 256 tax-exempt funds rose $791.8 million to $111.45 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 305 institutional money market funds rose $2.37 billion to $293.42 billion. Of these, the 242 taxable money market funds grew $1.83 billion to $263.35 billion, and assets of the 63 tax exempt funds rose $534.8 million to $30.08 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $898.17 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended November 13 were revised to $891.55 billion from $891.54 billion.
